Corollary
1. Corollary 4.23\group ch04-weak-solutions-part-ii Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0099 ↗ hanlin:weaksol-part2-moser-holder ↗ hanlin:weaksol-part2-nonlinear-harnack Suppose $u\in H^1(B_1)$ is a bounded solution of $(\ast )$ and $b$ satisfies the natural growth condition with $f\in L^q(B_1)$ for some $q>n/2$. Then $u\in C^\alpha _{\mathrm{loc}}(B_1)$ for some $\alpha \in (0,1)$ depending only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda ,q$, and $\| u\| _{L^\infty }$. Moreover, \[ |u(x)-u(y)|\leq C|x-y|^\alpha \qquad (x,y\in B_{1/2}), \] where $C$ depends only on $n,\lambda ,\Lambda ,q,\| u\| _{L^\infty (B_1)}$, and $\| f\| _{L^q(B_1)}$.
Proof

\sketch Repeat the oscillation argument for Corollary 11, replacing the linear Harnack estimate by Lemma 4.

□
